title: 1993 Country Fever USA II VHS, Hottest Line Dances - New
descriptionText: The product is a 1993 VHS tape of "Country Fever USA II: The Hottest Line Dances with Ed & Sally." It falls under the Music & Concerts genre, with a sub-genre of Country music. The VHS tape features line dances performed by Ed and Sally, catering specifically to country music enthusiasts. Produced by Brentwood Home Video, the English-language video is rated NR, making it suitable for all audiences interested in country music and line dance challenges.
